title: Brindille
subtitle: A little forest spirit crosses five lands to reach the top of the great tree.
controls: Run: arrows or WASD     Jump: Space, Up or W     Down + Jump: drop through a plank     R: back to the lantern     Esc: pause
hud_keys: Esc: pause     R: back to the lantern
pause_keys: Gamepad: d-pad or stick to run, A to jump, Start to pause, Back to return to the lantern.
final_text: Brindille has reached the top of the great tree. Replay the levels to beat your times and find every golden acorn.
sign_1_2: Space to jump. Hold it to jump higher.
sign_1_3: Jump on beetles to squash them. Touching them from the side makes you fall.
sign_1_4: Planks can be crossed from below. Down + Jump drops through.
sign_1_5: Jump again in mid-air for a double jump.
sign_1_6: Light the lanterns: after a fall you start again from the last one.
sign_1_7: Springs launch you very high. Steer in mid-air.
sign_2_1: In mid-air against a wall, jump to bounce off it. Alternate between both walls to climb.
sign_2_2: Watch out for thorns. Wasps can be stomped like beetles.
sign_2_3: Sliding down a wall slows your fall. Each wall jump gives back your double jump.
sign_2_4: Last chimney: the exit is at the very top.
sign_3_1: Cracked blocks collapse shortly after you step on them. Keep moving.
sign_3_3: Plants spit seeds. Jump over them or stomp the plant.
sign_3_4: The cracked stones barely hold: chain your jumps.
sign_4_1: Every jump swaps the amber and blue blocks. Jump to get through the amber wall.
sign_4_2: Dotted blocks turn solid the moment you jump. A double jump swaps them twice.
sign_4_3: Hedgehogs sting even from above: jump over them.
sign_4_4: The amber bridge vanishes when you jump. Count your jumps.
sign_4_5: A dotted wall can be crossed. Jump at the right moment.
sign_5_1: The final climb: everything you have learned is needed here.
sign_5_2: The exit is right there. Mind the hedgehog.
